cards.front: How do you change a fraction to a decimal?
cards.back: Divide the numerator by the denominator. Example: 3/4 = 3 ÷ 4 = 0.75.
cards.say: How do you change a fraction to a decimal? Divide the numerator by the denominator. Example: three quarters equals three divided by four equals zero point seven five.

cards.front: 1/8 as a decimal and a percentage
cards.say: one eighth as a decimal and a percentage. zero point one two five and twelve point five percent

figure.alt: A circle split into 8 equal parts with 1 shaded

cards.front: 3/8 as a decimal and a percentage
cards.say: three eighths as a decimal and a percentage. zero point three seven five and thirty seven point five percent

cards.front: 5/8 as a decimal and a percentage
cards.say: five eighths as a decimal and a percentage. zero point six two five and sixty two point five percent

cards.front: 7/8 as a decimal and a percentage
cards.say: seven eighths as a decimal and a percentage. zero point eight seven five and eighty seven point five percent

cards.front: 1/3 as a decimal and a percentage
cards.back: 0.333... and about 33.3%. The threes go on forever.
cards.say: One third as a decimal and a percentage. Zero point three three three and so on, and about thirty three point three percent. The threes go on forever.

cards.front: 2/3 as a decimal and a percentage
cards.say: Two thirds as a decimal and a percentage. Zero point six six six and so on, and about sixty six point seven percent.

cards.front: 1/25 as a decimal and a percentage
cards.say: one twenty fifth as a decimal and a percentage. zero point zero four and four percent. one twenty fifth equals four hundredths.

cards.front: 3/25 as a decimal and a percentage
cards.say: three twenty fifths as a decimal and a percentage. zero point one two and twelve percent. three twenty fifths equals twelve hundredths.

cards.front: 7/50 as a decimal and a percentage
cards.say: seven fiftieths as a decimal and a percentage. zero point one four and fourteen percent. seven fiftieths equals fourteen hundredths.

cards.front: 11/20 as a decimal and a percentage
cards.say: eleven twentieths as a decimal and a percentage. zero point five five and fifty five percent. eleven twentieths equals fifty five hundredths.

cards.front: 1 1/2 as a decimal and a percentage
cards.say: one and a half as a decimal and a percentage. one point five and one hundred and fifty percent.

cards.front: 2.5 as a percentage
cards.back: 250%. 2.5 is 2 whole ones (200%) plus a half (50%).
cards.say: two point five as a percentage. two hundred and fifty percent. two point five is two whole ones, two hundred percent, plus a half, fifty percent.

cards.front: 0.125 as a fraction in simplest form
cards.back: 1/8. 0.125 = 125/1000, and dividing top and bottom by 125 gives 1/8.
cards.say: Zero point one two five as a fraction in simplest form. One eighth. It is one hundred and twenty five thousandths, and dividing top and bottom by one hundred and twenty five gives one eighth.

cards.front: 0.8 as a fraction in simplest form
cards.say: zero point eight as a fraction in simplest form. four fifths. zero point eight equals eight tenths equals four fifths.

cards.front: 35% as a fraction in simplest form
cards.back: 7/20. 35/100 divided top and bottom by 5 gives 7/20.
cards.say: thirty five percent as a fraction in simplest form. seven twentieths. thirty five hundredths divided top and bottom by five gives seven twentieths.

cards.front: 12.5% as a fraction
cards.say: twelve point five percent as a fraction. one eighth. twelve point five percent is half of twenty five percent, and twenty five percent is one quarter.

cards.front: 0.04 as a percentage
cards.say: zero point zero four as a percentage. four percent. Multiply by one hundred.

cards.front: 1% as a fraction and decimal
cards.say: one percent as a fraction and decimal. one hundredth and zero point zero one.

cards.front: Which is bigger, 5/8 or 0.6?
cards.say: Which is bigger, five eighths or zero point six? five eighths, because five eighths equals zero point six two five and zero point six two five is more than zero point six.

cards.front: Order smallest to largest: 0.4, 3/8, 35%
cards.say: Order smallest to largest: zero point four, three eighths, thirty five percent. Thirty five percent, three eighths, zero point four. As decimals: point three five, point three seven five, point four.

cards.front: Order smallest to largest: 3/5, 55%, 0.58
cards.say: Order smallest to largest: three fifths, fifty five percent, zero point five eight. Fifty five percent, zero point five eight, three fifths. As decimals: point five five, point five eight, point six.

cards.front: Is 3/4 equal to 75%?
cards.say: Is three quarters equal to seventy five percent? Yes. three quarters equals zero point seven five equals seventy five hundredths equals seventy five percent.

cards.front: Which is the odd one out: 1/5, 0.2, 20%, 0.02?
cards.say: Which is the odd one out: one fifth, zero point two, twenty percent, zero point zero two? zero point zero two. The others all equal zero point two.
